question: **The Michael and Sheila Held Prize is presented:**

options.text: every year to honour those who solve longstanding problems in graph theory and linear algebra
every two years to honour the best researchers in mathematics
twice every year to honour young and influential researchers in mathematics
every year to honour new thinking and research in a specific area of mathematics

solution:
The correct answer is: **every year to honour new thinking and research in a specific area of mathematics**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The last sentence of the given paragraph states that,*"**The Michael and Sheila Held Prize is presented annually to honour outstanding, innovative, creative and influential research in the area of combinatorial mathematics.__**"*
 
• From here it is clear, The Michael and Sheila Held Prize is presented every year to honour new thinking and research in a specific area of mathematics.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
